annotations.title: chainpeek: an ERC-1155 token balance on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Get an account's ERC-1155 token balance for a token id on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For an ERC-721 owner use get_nft_owner. Returns balanceOf(account, id) of an ERC-1155 contract (`balance`, a raw integer string), with an ERC-165 check (`is_erc1155`) and the block read. A contract without balanceOf(address,uint256) is a 422 `not_erc1155` (not charged). Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html
